draft.summary: NFL.com graded him 5.80, the 185th-best grade among 241 2018 draftees and 12th of 14 at TE. He went 156th overall, well ahead of where his grade ranked (185th): teams liked him more than the published grade. Published comparison: Ben Koyack. Testing was middle of the pack for his position, with no result in the top or bottom 20%. College production: 547 receiving yards in 2017, 4th of 13 TEs in his class with stats.

current.summary: Current status: free agent. Last NFL action came in 2020. 19 career games and 5 starts over 2 completed seasons. Career-best season: 1 AV in 2020. Weak spots: season snap share 12.6% (8th percentile), receiving yards 80 (22nd percentile).
